question: The safety device that works on the heating effect of electric current is :
solution:
The correct answer is **'__Fuse__'. **

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Fuse is based on the **heating effect of current.**
 
• The** fuse breaks** a circuit if a fault in an appliance causes too much current to flow.
 
• This protects the wire and the appliance if something goes wrong.
 
• The fuse contains a piece of** wire that melts **easily.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Switch: **An electric switch is **a device that interrupts the electron flow in a circuit**. Switches are primarily binary devices: either fully on or off and light switches have a simple design. When the switch is turned off, the circuit breaks and the power flow is interrupted.
 
• **Heater:** A heater is a device for **supplying heat**, It converts **electric current into heat**. for example a radiator or a convector. These water heaters heat water only when it is needed.
 
• **Electric motor: **An electric motor is **an electrical machine that converts electrical energy into mechanical energy**.
